name: Capture AI
description: Engine-provided AI that owns a team and never issues a single command — it dumps AIStateSnapshot data (own units, visible enemies, the region graph, the objective board, departure zones) to the server log as JSON, one line per sample. tools/ai-eval/capture.mjs greps that log out of a real `--headless-run` and turns it into a RECORDED tools/ai-eval fixture, so the eval matrix isn't entirely hand-authored synthetic data. Put it on the team you want to observe; put a real AI (garrison/strategos) on the opposing team so there is something worth capturing.
author: spring-web
